verdict.summary_en: Polish goods issue note (Dokument WZ) WZ-260908-528 dated 09.09.2026 from Karton Nowak, Poznań, to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg against order 4500318712. It lists 65,000 PCS of CMP-GAM-004 in 32 packages and 28,000 PCS of CMP-GAM-009 in 5 packages. The totals are 37 packages and 481 kg gross. The document has no handwritten corrections, stamps or remarks.
red_flags: The receiver's signature line (Odebrał) is blank, so there is no signed confirmation of receipt and no receiving stamp or date.
Both item descriptions are cut off in the printed table ("(USK/PE" and "(fol").
observations: The document is a clean printed scan with no handwriting, stamps or crossed-out values.
The quantities use the Polish thousands separator (65.000 = 65000, 28.000 = 28000).
The package counts are consistent: 32 + 5 = 37, which matches the stated total.
The carrier is given as 'PO 11003'. It is unclear whether this is a carrier name or an order-type code.
A barcode is printed at the top right.
The lower half of the page is blank.
